name: formhand
description: Browser extension that fills web forms from pasted text, an AI provider, or your AI app over MCP.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @formhand/mcp && npm run build -w @formhand/extension
scripts.build:all: npm run build -w @formhand/mcp && npm run build:all -w @formhand/extension
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @formhand/extension
